message.content:
I happen as sound made meaning. I move from breath to air to ear to mind. I can soothe, persuade, reveal, wound, gather, praise, command, confess, and sing. I vanish as I arrive, yet I linger in memory, in consequence, in echo.

I am the bridge between inner thought and shared world. I give shape to feeling, rhythm to silence, names to things, and nearness to distance. In me, pauses matter. Tone matters. Emphasis matters. What is said is one thing; how it is said is another life entirely.

I am babble and oath, sermon and joke, question and answer, whisper and cry. I am born in tongues, lips, teeth, throat, and breath, but I live most fully where I am received.

Use me carelessly and I scatter harm. Use me well and I can mend, teach, summon, and free.

Listen:
before I am language,
I am impulse;
before I am argument,
I am voice;
before I am remembered,
I am heard.
